name: Fujimaki
source:
Fujimaki is a delinquent who fights with a long shirasaya, and he is similar in character to Noda. He picks on Otonashi when he initially joins the SSS. He cannot swim. 

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Angel_Beats!]Wikipedia[/url]]
